title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
纽约布鲁克林区。十九世纪初期这里只是一个大家族的农场，后来分割成一小块一小块地皮，建造起一栋栋房子，形成了现在社区。十九世纪末期，在人们投票认同下，布鲁克林正式划归纽约市，成为纽约五大区之一。近300万的人口的251平方公里的占地面积，让它一跃成为纽约最大的区。只是相比于对岸穿金戴银，享受镁光灯照耀的世界之都曼哈顿，布鲁克林显得底气不足，就像一个地主家的穷亲戚，不受人待见。而且由于曾为黑人等少数族裔聚居区，这里是犯罪率最高的地区之一，常年充斥着暴力、犯罪和黑色垃圾。但即使如此，当纽约警局接到热心市民的报警电话，赶往黑帮火拼的案发现场，还是觉得这里的场面未免太夸张了点。到处都是被子弹打得稀烂的尸体和满地的弹壳枪支。仿佛一片血肉残肢的修罗地狱。血腥之气扑面而来。“呕。”一个刚进警局的女警看到这血腥画面，忍不住捂住嘴干呕。走在最前方目光锐利，两鬓微微发白的中年白人警长回头看了她一眼，面色如常地站在原地发号施令，让属下拉起警戒线，不要破坏现场，同时通知鉴定科和法医科的同事过来。“乔治警长，调查结果出来了。”没过多久，就有警员带来附近居民提供的一些线索。乔治.詹特利目光从地面上被法医科、鉴定科同事包围的尸体挪开，接过文件，大致略过后，紧皱的眉头不仅没有得到舒缓，反而带着整张脸都皱了起来。弗里曼.摩根，弗里曼手枪党首领，一个穷凶极恶但又狡诈如狐的犯罪分子。纽约警方一直对他有所关注，但却并没有找到他决定性的犯罪证据。这样一个谨慎的家伙，怎么做出如此不智的事情？？不仅自己这次在跟爱尔兰帮的火拼中身死，一手创立的弗里曼手枪党也在这次的斗争中死伤惨重，分崩离析。“先去找一下弗里曼手枪党幸存下来的成员，看看他们知不知道什么，还有，重点调查弗里曼这半个月的资金往来还有通话记录，我要知道他这段时间都干了什么。”“YES，SIR。”......一晚上死了几百个人的特大枪击案，即使这些人都是些该死的帮派分子，这件事情还是在纽约引起了不小的波动。没一会儿，关于这件事情的报道就出现在各大新闻媒体上面。《纽约警局的无能给我们带来了什么？？》

《这就是枪支泛滥会引发的后果！！》《布鲁克林的混乱什么时候能够结束？》媒体五花八门的报道给这件事情带来了更大关注度的同时，也给纽约警方施加了更大的压力。不过这些暂时跟陆白没什么关系。他此时正坐在一家二十四小时营业的快餐店里，神色若有所思地将心神沉浸在白泽精怪图之中。能明显看到，原本灰蒙蒙的白泽精怪图上已经有两幅栩栩如生的异兽画像被点亮。正是举父和比翼鸟。不过陆白这次关注的却并不是它们。而是白泽精怪图中正在快速增加的灰白色气流，也即是本来已经被他用掉大半的愿力。自从那些新闻媒体开始报道弗里曼手枪党和爱尔兰帮的火拼事件之后。顺着冥冥中的联系，就有一大波情绪力量被他脑海中的白泽精怪图转化成了愿力。所以，这才是白泽精怪图的正确用法？在现实世界搞事情收集愿力，再用这些愿力拓印那些山海异兽的天赋能力，不断提升自己？？陆白心中若有所悟，收回心神，端起桌上热气腾腾的黑咖啡喝了一口。“先生，你第一次来，这是我们店送给你的芝士三明治。”这时，长相颇为甜美的金发女服务员扭动着纤细腰肢，又送上了一盘三明治，并且盘子下面还压着一张写有联系方式的字条。“谢谢。”陆白笑着朝她点点头，拓印自比翼鸟的天赋能力能看透这位标准美国大妞此时对他的想法，也能感知到方圆百米内所有生物的情绪。其中眼前这位女服务员不用说，情绪颜色是粉红色的，脑海中尽是些少儿不宜的画面。而其他人大部分都是偏向白色的，想的大多是工作或者家庭方面的一些事情。唯有坐在快餐店角落里衣着邋遢，浑身上下都散发着颓废气质的中年白人男子，情绪完全是一片绝望的黑色。这引起了陆白的几分注意。或许他可以借由对方试试，白泽精怪图获取愿力的方式是不是如他所想的那样。
content_en:
Brooklyn, New York.In the early 19th century, this was just a farm belonging to a large family. Later, it was divided into small pieces of land and houses were built, forming the current community.At the end of the 19th century, with people's approval by vote, Brooklyn was officially included in New York City and became one of the five boroughs of New York.With a population of nearly 3 million and an area of ​​251 square kilometers, it has become the largest borough in New York.But compared to Manhattan, the capital of the world that wears gold and silver and enjoys the spotlight on the other side, Brooklyn seems to lack confidence, like a poor relative of a landlord's family, unpopular.And because it was once an area inhabited by blacks and other ethnic minorities, it has one of the highest crime rates and is filled with violence, crime and black garbage all year round.But even so, when the New York Police Department received a call from enthusiastic citizens and rushed to the scene of the gang fight, they still felt that the scene here was a bit too exaggerated.There were bullet-riddled bodies everywhere and guns with bullet casings strewn on the ground.It was like a Shura hell of flesh and blood.The smell of blood rushed to his face."Ugh." A female police officer who had just entered the police station couldn't help covering her mouth and retching when she saw the bloody scene.The middle-aged white police chief who was walking at the front with sharp eyes and slightly white temples looked back at her. He stood there with a normal expression and gave orders, asking his subordinates to set up a cordon and not to damage the scene. At the same time, he notified colleagues from the identification department and forensic department to come over."Chief George, the investigation results are out." It didn't take long for police officers to bring some clues provided by nearby residents.George Gentry moved his eyes away from the corpse on the ground surrounded by colleagues from the Forensic Medicine Department and the Identification Department, took the document, and after roughly skimming it, his frowning brows were not relieved, but instead his whole face wrinkled.Freeman Morgan, leader of the Freeman Pistol Gang, is a vicious but cunning criminal.The New York police have been paying attention to him, but they have not found conclusive evidence of his crime.How could such a cautious guy do such an unwise thing??Not only did he die in a fight with the Irish Gang, but the Freeman Pistol Party he founded also suffered heavy casualties and fell apart in this struggle."First go find the surviving members of Freeman's Pistol Gang and see if they know anything. Also, focus on investigating Freeman's financial transactions and call records in the past half month. I want to know what he has been doing during this time." "YES, SIR."... A huge shooting that killed hundreds of people in one night. Even though these people were all damn gang members, this incident still caused quite a stir in New York.Soon, reports about this incident appeared in major news media."What has the NYPD's incompetence taught us?"?》

"This is the consequence of the proliferation of guns!"!"When will the chaos in Brooklyn end?""The various media reports have brought greater attention to this matter, and at the same time put greater pressure on the New York police.But these have nothing to do with Lu Bai for the time being.He was currently sitting in a 24-hour fast food restaurant, looking thoughtful and immersed in Bai Ze's ghost paintings.It can be clearly seen that two lifelike portraits of strange beasts have been lit up on the originally gray Bai Ze monster picture.It is Jufu and Biyiniao.But Lu Bai was not focused on them this time.It's the rapidly increasing gray-white air flow in Bai Ze's ghost picture, which means that he has already used up most of his will power.Ever since those news outlets started reporting on the fight between the Freeman Pistols and the Irish Gang.Following the mysterious connection, a large wave of emotional power was transformed into willing power by the Bai Ze spirit picture in his mind.So, is this the correct way to use Bai Ze’s ghost picture?Do things in the real world to collect willpower, and then use these willpower to imprint the talents of those strange beasts in the mountains and seas, and continuously improve yourself??Lu Bai realized something in his heart, he recovered his mind, picked up the steaming black coffee on the table and took a sip."Sir, this is your first time here. This is a cheese sandwich from our store." At this time, the sweet-looking blonde waitress twisted her slender waist and brought another plate of sandwiches, and there was a note with contact information under the plate."Thank you." Lu Bai smiled and nodded to her. The innate ability copied from Biyiniao could see through what this standard American girl was thinking about him at this time, and he could also sense the emotions of all living creatures within a hundred meters.Needless to say, the waitress in front of me was pink in color, and her mind was filled with images that were not suitable for children.Most of the others tend to be white and think mostly about work or family matters.Only the middle-aged white man sitting in the corner of the fast food restaurant, dressed slovenly and exuding a decadent temperament, his mood was completely black and despairing.This attracted Lu Bai's attention.Maybe he could use the other party to try and see if Bai Ze Jinggui Tu's method of obtaining wish power was what he thought.
